answer: Every identity locks a 75 POA bond for 21 days before acting, so one fake costs 75 POA frozen three weeks and a farm cannot reuse one bond across identities. A marble receipt is minted per bond and published for inspection. Randomly assigned auditors check receipts against real activity, and the orchard of linked accounts around a fake is pruned when one fails. On forgery, the bond is forfeited, the identity is removed, and the terrace record stays public so the fraud cannot be hidden.
